name: Atomic action annotation: Astra versus Sol
comparison_rules: Both models use the same shared prompt file: annotation.txt.
Supply identical task metadata, camera evidence, timestamps, and telemetry to both models.
Label independently without predictions or reference labels from other models or earlier runs.
Use fresh run outputs; preserve the prompt and input evidence used for that run.
output_contract: Atomic action fields and linked local task/failure segments are defined in the shared prompt; historical state-only validators do not implement this contract.
